charge_port.notes: Electrek: the 2020 Soul EV moved to CCS, "previous models used CHAdeMO" (Wikipedia and Fastned agree). Caveat: some early US trims may have lacked the DC port; not verified.

supercharger_access.notes: Estimated: Kia US/Canada Supercharger adapter offers cover CCS-port Kias only; a CHAdeMO car has no adapter route.
